# Project Atlas — Progress Log

> **SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE — FICTIONAL DATA.**

Entries are written in the order they were recorded, which is not chronological order.
Date formats are inconsistent on purpose.

## 2025-03-10

Initial proposal written and circulated. Scope set as in README.md.

## March 14

Chassis parts ordered. Assembly started. No year is recorded in this entry, and the
entry appears after later entries in this file.

## 2025-04-02

First drive test on a bench. Chassis moved under remote control. No autonomous run
was attempted.

## 2025/04/17

Sensor board integrated. Temperature and humidity sensors connected.

## Late April

Battery pack delivered. No exact day is recorded, so this entry cannot be placed
precisely against the 2025-04-17 entry.

## 2025-05-06

Public field trial held at the north prototype site. Roughly 40 minutes of autonomous
running was demonstrated. Attendance was not recorded.

## 2025-06-01

Firmware v0.9 released internally.

## Undated

Waypoint upload tool finished. The date was never written down. The entry sits between
two dated entries in this file but its true position in the sequence is unknown.
